column2: How do I transcribe a document with the full tool, and read the handwriting with the AI on my computer?
column3: On a document page (Documents tab), “📜 Transcribe” opens the transcription workshop on its image: the transcription already started, otherwise a new one. For the AI that reads the whole page on your computer (Qwen3-VL with Ollama): Settings → Handwriting recognition (HTR) → “🔍 Install or check in-depth reading…”. Nothing goes to the Internet except the model download.
